caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a wooden horse collar, shown in a U-shape with the open ends at the bottom and the curved top facing upwards. The collar is composed of two separate halves joined at the top by a metal clasp or hinge, which is colored in a muted brass or copper tone. The body of the collar is a uniform medium brown hue, representing the wood, with visible grain and shading that suggests a smooth, polished surface. The inner edge of the wooden leaves is rounded, while the outer edge is broader and gently contoured. Small circular metal rings, also in muted brass color, are attached symmetrically on both sides of each half of the collar, embedded along the outer edge for connecting harness components. The background is a plain off-white or light beige color with no additional objects, textures, or details, focusing entirely on the isolated depiction of the horse collar.
title: Horse Collar and Hame
